budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Survive three finite day/night cycles by building and maintaining a shared insulated, fueled shelter; balance communal materials against individual private stash priorities.
task.natural_termination: All workers reach zero health, or clock reaches the third sunrise at t=54. Sunrise is natural termination even though it equals H; truncation remains false then.
task.interaction: A worker wall, lining or fuel contribution changes every nearby worker later weather protection; kiln production consumes common finite material and creates local smoke, while handoffs and stashing change partner inventory opportunities.
task.observation_access: Map, bodies, inventories, node quantities, construction, kiln, public current weather and aggregate locker contents are public. Role i sees only its preferred material and forecast for night i. Other forecasts and priorities are never entity attributes.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Indices: 0 gathered; 1 wall/lining added; 2 kiln loaded; 3 lining collected; 4 hearth fed or smoke vented; 5 material passed; 6 private stash; 7 health damage or wall wear.
Current public weather: 0 daylight, 1 cold night, 2 severe cold night
Current kiln smoke; at six or more it creates local fire damage
Wall levels permanently lost to weather or fire

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
